about: Pocket candidates: both int8 files published under explicit names (vision.int8-per-tensor.onnx, vision.int8-per-channel.onnx) with image vectors over eval/alachua-2025 from each, so quantization loss can be measured per file whatever vision.int8.onnx points at; species label sets (5911 species from pub/data-alachua) for the TinyCLIPs and CLIP B/32 published now rather than with run 3.
